name: Emerging Images
description: Scroll-revealed WebGL image grid where each image emerges through a shader transition such as pixel wipe, noise curtain or dither fade as it enters the viewport, with captions and smooth scrolling.
contents: Staggered grid of images, each with title and year caption
Fixed full-viewport WebGL canvas rendering one shader view per image
behavior: Each image animates from a flat fill color into the picture when it enters the viewport and reverses when it leaves
Five shader reveal styles selectable by variant
Grid collapses to a single column on screens 53em and below
editableByProps: Items with titles, years, grid row, column and span, and images
Reveal style, duration, easing and trigger margin
Fill, background, text, title and year colors
Grid columns, gap, padding, image ratio, font and size
Smooth scroll on or off and its lerp

needsCodeEdit.change: Tweak or add shader reveal effects
needsCodeEdit.where: EmergeMaterial fragment shader branches on uType
easings object inside useFrame in EmergeMesh

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis unless smoothScroll is false, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Renders one fixed full-viewport WebGL canvas with pointer events disabled above the page
Images must allow cross-origin loading for WebGL textures
Grid positions come from each item's r, c and s values on screens wider than 53em

options.look: Image wipes in left to right as a pixelated grid that sharpens, with a colored gradient edge
options.useWhen: A portfolio gallery needs a techy, digital reveal on scroll

options.look: Grainy fill color curtain with noisy edge sweeps up to uncover the image
options.useWhen: A photography or editorial page wants a textured print-like reveal

options.look: Fine dithered dots dissolve from fill color into the image from top to bottom
options.useWhen: A retro or minimal brand page wants a subtle fade-in

options.look: Wavy pixelated dissolve that resolves into the image with a tinted edge
options.useWhen: A creative studio page wants a fluid organic reveal

options.look: Whole image starts heavily pixelated and sharpens in place
options.useWhen: A lookbook or product gallery wants a clean focus-in with no color overlay
